pr.title: Test prep
pr.whichSub: Choose the units on the test and the date. I build the test scope from them.
pr.removeSure: Remove it? Your notes stay stored until they are deleted automatically.
pr.addSub: I find the test topics and explanations in them. Anything I can't read reliably is marked with [?], and I don't guess.
pr.pastePh: Paste your notes or test material …
pr.noSources: No notes yet. You can also continue without them.

pr.srcUnsure.one: {n} place is uncertain [?]. Check it in your notebook when you get to it.
pr.srcUnsure.other: {n} places are uncertain [?]. Check them in your notebook when you get to them.

pr.srcScanLeft: Scanned pages are still waiting to be read.
pr.quota: Photos and scanned pages use pages from your monthly limit ({n} left).
pr.quotaNone: Photos and scanned pages use pages from your monthly limit.
pr.privacy: Originals are encrypted and deleted 30 days after the test; you can delete them at any time.
pr.skipNotes: Continue without notes (topics from the curriculum)
pr.err.priprava_vrsta: I can't read this type of file. Add a photo, PDF, Word or PowerPoint file.
pr.err.priprava_viri_polno: This test prep already has the maximum number of sources.
pr.err.priprava_prostor: There is no more space for sources. Delete old test preps or sources.
pr.err.priprava_zasedeno: An upload is already running. Try again in a few seconds.
pr.err.priprava_brez_kljuca: Saving notes is not available right now.
pr.err.zapiski_strani: You have used all your pages for reading photos this month.
pr.err.priprava_slika_velika: The photo is too large to read. Take it again.
pr.err.mock: Reading photos is not available in test mode.
pr.err.branje_prazno: I found no text in the photo.
pr.err.branje_velika: The photo is too large to read.
pr.err.uvoz_pdf_geslo: The PDF is locked with a password.
pr.err.uvoz_cas: Reading the file took too long.
pr.err.other: The file could not be read.
pr.topicsSub: I matched the topics with Evklid lessons; remove anything that isn't on the test.
pr.topicsSubNoScope: Topics I found in your notes.
pr.coverage: Your notes cover {a} of {b} test topics.

pr.unmatched.one: I couldn't match {n} excerpt to a topic; it stays in your notes.
pr.unmatched.other: I couldn't match {n} excerpts to a topic; they stay in your notes.

pr.partial: You have a lot of notes; I searched for topics in the first {n} excerpts.
pr.noTopics: I found no curriculum topics in your notes.
pr.startQuizSub: 6 tasks from the chosen topics · about 5 minutes
pr.startQuizNote: After the quiz I know what you already know and build a daily plan up to the test.
pr.noQuizTopics: None of the test topics has quiz tasks. I'll build the plan from your notes.
pr.readyNone: I'll show how ready you are once you solve your first tasks.
pr.readyText: {a} of {b} topics mastered with solved tasks. Only what you have shown counts, not time spent in the app.
pr.readyNoGrade: The percentage is not a grade and can drop when reviews come up.
pr.keepOne: At least one topic must stay on the test.
pr.todayEmpty: Nothing else is planned for today.

pr.squeezed.one: There aren't enough days before the test for everything: {n} unit won't fit.
pr.squeezed.other: There aren't enough days before the test for everything: {n} units won't fit.

pr.unsureNote: This page has a place I couldn't read reliably [?]. Check it in your notebook.

pr.dropped.one: I couldn't back {n} paragraph with your notes, so I don't show it.
pr.dropped.other: I couldn't back {n} paragraphs with your notes, so I don't show them.

pr.notCorrect: Backed by your notes doesn't always mean correct: if your notebook has a mistake, find it with the tutor.
pr.stale: Your notes have changed since this explanation.
pr.makeExplText: I build the explanation only from your notes on this topic; every paragraph has a quote and a page. It uses 1 page of your monthly limit.
pr.noCuts: Your notes have no excerpts on this topic. Use the textbook lesson or practise tasks.
pr.err.razlaga_nepreverjena: The explanation could not be checked against your notes. Try again or add notes.
pr.err.razlaga_poteka: An explanation is already being prepared.
pr.err.razlaga_mock: Explanations are not available in test mode.
pr.err.razlaga_zapiski_spremenjeni: Your notes changed while the explanation was being prepared. Try again.
pr.quizIntro: Tasks from the test topics. A computer checks each one, not AI.
pr.quizScore: {a} of {b} correct on the first try
pr.quizChecked: A computer checked every answer, not AI.
pr.planMock: The day before the test there is a practice test.
pr.noForecast: Readiness only goes up with solved tasks. I don't predict grades.
